about: Segment field names, data types and repeat rules for HL7 Version 2, taken from the mapping tables of the HL7 Version 2 to FHIR project published by HL7 International. Reformatted to JSON; segment titles added.

fields.name: Next of Kin / Associated Parties Job Title
Next of Kin / Associated Parties Job Code/Class
Next of Kin / Associated Parties Employee Number

corrections: Checked against the HL7 v2.9 standard text (segment attribute tables) and corrected: ORC-8 and OBR-54 repeat; OBR-17 repeats up to 2 times (the source table had the text 0..2 in the minimum column); MSH-6 repeats; ORC-4 is Placer Order Group Number with data type EI, and ORC-9 is Date/Time of Order Event (the source had the v2.8 values; the older ORC-9 name is kept in otherNames); OBR-29 Parent Results Observation Identifier (a space was missing); OBX-7 Reference Range (the source had References Range, the name up to v2.8.2); DG1-1 Set ID - DG1 and DG1-3 Diagnosis Code - DG1 (the source had the names without the segment); AL1-3 is optional and AL1-6 and DG1-2 are withdrawn, so their minimum is 0; the names of OBR-14, OBR-20 to OBR-23, OBR-25, OBR-26 and OBR-32 to OBR-39 no longer end with the footnote marks * and + of the order chapter. Withdrawn fields keep the data type and repeat rule of the last version before they were withdrawn, as in the older HL7 tables: PID-4 repeats, PID-20 is DLN, OBR-6 and OBR-14 are DTM, OBR-15 is SPS. OBR-55 Action Code (data type ID, new in v2.9) was missing in the source and is added.
